categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the 'lock' keyword only via holding cs_main; it changes block storage and block index traversal rather than utility infrastructure or synchronization primitives.
categories.rationale: Does not alter utility primitives or shared helper libraries.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches block file pruning and block index traversal (part of validation and block storage).
categories.rationale: Eliminates multi-minute node startup freezes caused by holding `cs_main` across O(M * N) iterations during bulk pruning. Author benchmarks demonstrate reducing lock hold time from 606.0s down to 26.3ms on a Raspberry Pi 5 across 5,770 pruned files.
